Package dev.metaschema.databind.model.metaschema

Class BindingModuleLoader

java.lang.Object
dev.metaschema.core.model.AbstractLoader<M>
dev.metaschema.core.model.AbstractModuleLoader<METASCHEMA,IBindingMetaschemaModule>
dev.metaschema.databind.model.metaschema.BindingModuleLoader
All Implemented Interfaces:
IConfiguration<DeserializationFeature<?>>, IMutableConfiguration<DeserializationFeature<?>>, ILoader<IBindingMetaschemaModule>, IModuleLoader<IBindingMetaschemaModule>, IBindingModuleLoader
public class BindingModuleLoader extends AbstractModuleLoader<METASCHEMA,IBindingMetaschemaModule> implements IBindingModuleLoader
Loads Metaschema modules from XML or YAML sources using data binding.

This class provides functionality to parse Metaschema module files and construct the corresponding module model.
